svg.title: About
svg.desc: Senior engineer on CoreWeave billing — mostly Go on Kubernetes. Not a tools team. Still the one asking why that alert did not page. Earlier: AWS boto3 maintainer, then backend at The New York Times. NYC native. Dry humor. Freshly caffeinated preferred.
